summary: Iteration 10 (LiquidAudio: genre chips + karaoke lyrics + player swipe gestures + liquid pull-to-refresh + 'Because you played' recs). FRONTEND (web preview, 390x844). PASSED: (1) Genre chips For You/Hindi/English/Punjabi respond to plain tap (no force) and switch both `Trending in <lang>` header AND the Featured hero — hero titles observed: For You=Rula Ke Gaya Ishq / Hindi=Kabhi Shaam Dhale / English=Go Down Deh (Sean Paul & Shaggy) / Punjabi=Qatal (Guru Randhawa). Trending row cards are language-appropriate. (2) Pull-to-refresh via mouse drag from Featured area (y≈420): liquid-refresh header height grows from 10→130 over 20 mouse-move steps (heights=[10,10,14.9,22.3,29.8,37.2,44.6,52.1,59.5,66.9,74.4,81.8,89.3,96.7,104.2,111.6,119.0,126.5,130]), 'Release to refresh' text appears mid-drag, 'Refreshing your feed…' appears after release, Featured hero re-shuffled to 'Baarish Mein Tum'/'Tu hai kahan' after refresh, final header height ≈10 (near-zero, still settling but visually collapsed). home-refresh header button also still works (rotating icon). (3) Mini-player swipe UP (mouse-down + incremental up-drag): opened player-panel-bar successfully. (4) player-tab-upnext opens player-panel (queue-screen) WITHOUT an inner tab strip (queue-tabs count=0 ✓); queue-close closes it. (5) player-tab-lyrics renders lyrics-view; /lyrics URL route renders lyrics-screen. (6) No red console errors from reanimated/useFrameCallback/worklets. (7) REGRESSION: home-search-shortcut → search-input; typed 'arijit' → suggest-text-*, suggest-fill-* rendered (Arijit Singh, Gehra Hua, Tum Hi Ho…). home-settings → settings-screen. /jam → jam-start → jam-code (INVITE CODE PEQ2NG shown). Made-for-you mix cards rendered (Discover/Hindi/English Mix). CRITICAL FAILURES: (a) 'Because you played …' recommendation rows NEVER RENDER on Home even 12s after tapping a track, even though the backend endpoint /api/tracks/{id}/recommendations?limit=20 returns 200 with 20 tracks and /api/library shows recent_len=1. Network trace shows the frontend NEVER issues a /api/tracks/*/recommendations call after playback starts. Root cause = library query firing under TWO different device_ids (dev_3m54rnr… vs dev_8jfq5u90… seen in the same session), so `useLibrary().recent` in index.tsx stays [] even though addRecent POSTed to a third device id (dev_8osp4z8…). See RCA. (b) Player SWIPE-DOWN close on player-drag-zone does NOT dismiss the player on web preview: 30×10px mouse-down-move-up drag (300px total, well above 140 threshold) starting on the artwork keeps player-panel-bar count=1 and home-screen not visible. The equivalent mini-player swipe-UP (activeOffsetY([-9999,-14])) DOES work with the same mouse-emulation technique, so this is a gesture wiring issue in /app/frontend/app/player.tsx (dismiss Pan.onEnd → goBack) rather than a Playwright limitation. player-close button (top-left chevron-down) still works as fallback. (c) Karaoke word-by-word sweep could NOT be sampled on web because active-lyric-line does not appear (audio position stays at 0 so no line becomes active — see note). Static styles compile OK; no reanimated errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Swipe-down on player-drag-zone does not close the player. onEnd's dragY.value>140 branch never fires on web with mouse-emulated touch drag of 300px vertical (steps of 10px/20ms) while mini-player's equivalent swipe-UP Pan works with the SAME technique. Likely the panel state check or the Pan .activeOffsetY([18,9999]) is failing to activate, or router.back() is a no-op when /player was pushed onto an empty history. Please repro on device and verify goBack() executes.

'Because you played …' rows never render after playing a track. Two DIFFERENT device_ids fire /api/library within the same session (dev_3m54rn… & dev_8jfq5u9… observed) while addRecent used a THIRD device_id (dev_8osp4z8…). Because seeds derives from useLibrary().recent (empty for the mismatched device), useQueries never fires /api/tracks/*/recommendations. Root cause: useDeviceId() is racy / returns different ids across effect passes.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend never calls /api/tracks/{id}/recommendations because the library query is bound to a stale device_id different from the one that received the addRecent POST. Backend endpoint is healthy (200 + 20 tracks).

issues: Liquid-refresh header does not fully collapse to 0 after refresh finishes (residual ~10px). Cosmetic only.

action_items: Fix useDeviceId (src/lib/device.ts) so it returns a single stable device_id across all consumers within a session — currently addRecent and useLibrary receive different ids, breaking 'Because you played'.

Debug the player.tsx dismiss Pan gesture: verify Gesture.Pan().activeOffsetY([18,9999]).onEnd(...) is actually reached on web (add a runOnJS log). If reached but router.back() is a no-op, use `if (router.canGoBack()) router.back(); else router.replace('/');` fallback.

Consider springing pull.value back to exactly 0 after refresh completes (currently lands ~10px, cosmetic) — likely a stale busy check in liquid-refresh.tsx onEnd branch when the pull was released while refreshing was still true.
Reproduce karaoke sweep on native / with a playable stream so lines actually become active (web can't play the AAC-in-mp4, so clock advances but no active-lyric-line appears).
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/hooks.ts useLibrary queryKey=['library', deviceId] — cache keyed per device. audio-context invalidates with queryKey=['library'] (prefix) which does work, BUT if `deviceId` differs between hook instances the invalidation only refreshes the currently-mounted-with-that-key query. Observed 2+ device_ids in one session → likely useDeviceId returns undefined first render then a fresh id later; or the hook regenerates on every mount.

app/player.tsx (line 78-93): dismiss uses activeOffsetY([18,9999]) which is fine; the onEnd triggers goBack() via runOnJS. Suggestion: log inside onEnd to confirm it runs; also consider using .simultaneousWithExternalGesture on the inner GestureDetector so the outer scroll gestures don't cancel it.

src/components/liquid-refresh.tsx (line 74-82 useEffect): when refreshing goes false the pull springs to 0. But onEnd already springs to HOLD before setting busy — a small race can leave pull > 0 after finally. Not blocking.

src/components/lyrics-view.tsx Word/LyricLine: uses interpolateColor + eased sweep — implementation is correct; no worklet or useFrameCallback errors were emitted on load. Cannot verify sweep visually on web because audio position never advances.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (7/10 checks green): chips ✓, pull-to-refresh liquid header ✓, mini-player swipe-UP ✓, player-panel no inner tabs ✓, lyrics-view mount + /lyrics route ✓, search/settings/jam regressions ✓, home-refresh button ✓ | FAILED: because-you-played ✗, player swipe-DOWN close ✗, karaoke sweep un-sampleable on web ✗

seed_data_creation: None. Recent-play POST created 1 entry under an ephemeral device_id which is auto-generated by getDeviceId(); no explicit cleanup necessary (per-device data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home genre chips already tap without force (Pressable onPress) — no issue. Pull-to-refresh mouse-drag from Featured area (start y≈420, drag down ≥180px in 12-15px steps at 20-25ms) DOES fire on web; header grows to MAX_PULL=130 and 'Release to refresh'/'Refreshing your feed' show. Mini-player swipe-UP (mouse down at mini-player centre, move up 12*12px, release) opens /player. BUT swipe-DOWN on player-drag-zone (start at artwork ~y=200, move down 30*10px) does NOT dismiss the player — this is a real bug (not a Playwright limitation because the analogous UP gesture works). 'Because you played' section rendering also broken because /api/tracks/*/recommendations is NEVER called by the frontend — root-caused to useDeviceId returning different ids across the addRecent path vs the useLibrary hook in Home. When retesting, verify (a) network shows a /api/tracks/{id}/recommendations after tap, (b) [data-testid^='because-'] count ≥1, and (c) tapping an artwork card inside that section changes mini-player title.
rca_of_issue: 1) Because-you-played rows missing: index.tsx line 122 reads library from useLibrary(); its queryKey is ['library', deviceId]. audio-context.tsx line 202-206 calls getDeviceId() then addRecent(id, current) then queryClient.invalidateQueries({queryKey:['library']}). Network trace shows THREE different device_ids in one session: dev_8osp4z8 (localStorage), dev_3m54rn (first useLibrary), dev_8jfq5u9 (second useLibrary). Because seeds is derived from library.recent for a device that never received the addRecent POST, seeds is empty and useQueries has no queries to fire, so no recommendations request is issued and no `because-` element is rendered. Fix: make useDeviceId synchronous/memoised so all consumers see the same value; or key useQueries off the *audio-context's* current+recent list rather than via the library round-trip. 2) Player swipe-down doesn't close: verified with a 300px vertical mouse-emulated drag on player-drag-zone (well above the 140 threshold) — home-screen still not visible, panel-bar still present. The mirrored mini-player swipe-UP works with identical technique, so this is a wiring bug (Pan.onEnd not reached, or goBack() no-op) rather than emulation limitation. Fix: instrument Pan.onEnd with runOnJS(console.log), and use `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)')` as the dismiss target.
